attempts.rationale: Robust baseline: median over all 19 models to handle unstable rankings (tau=0.22) and correlated error groups without overweighting any single model.
Test whether inverse-error weighting exploits the 1.48x spread better than unweighted median; robust to unstable ranking since all models still contribute
Robust combination per decision card; trims extreme predictions to handle unstable ranking (tau=0.22) and correlated error groups while preserving diversity across 8 clusters
DBA directly optimizes convex combination weights; different kind from aggregation rules. Unstable ranking and 8 correlation groups suggest optimal weights differ from uniform/inverse-error.
Narrower pool of top-7 SMAPE models with simple mean; tests whether excluding weaker correlated models improves robustness given unstable ranking (tau=0.22) and strong trend/seasonality
Robust combination on the top-7 pool: trim the weakest model to reduce variance from unstable ranking (tau=0.22) while keeping the strong trend/seasonal models
DBA on the small pool4 to test per-step optimization vs global trimmed mean; strong seasonality and unstable ranking suggest step-level adaptation may help
Per-horizon top-k (k=4, smape) on full pool: adapts model selection to horizon, addressing unstable ranking (tau=0.22) and strong seasonality where different models may excel at different steps
Diverse pool: one model from each of the 4 independent correlation groups, testing whether cross-group diversification beats the correlated pool4
Error-proportional weighting within the already-good pool4; strong trend means lower-error models should get more influence than equal-weight mean/trimmed_mean
Per-horizon top-3 selection on pool4 to exploit horizon-specific model strengths under unstable ranking (tau=0.22) and strong seasonality
Test sharper concentration on top pool4 models vs inverse_error; softmax penalizes weaker models more aggressively, potentially helping when last-window FT models dominate

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8769.
